overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the July 20 and 23, 2021 executive sessions concerned pending litigation (proper under Purpose 3), and the separate outside-deliberation claim was declined as already decided in OML 2022-28. The AG recommended the Board review the executive session minutes for release, but ordered no remedy.

allegations.summary: Complainants alleged the Board improperly discussed the building inspector position in executive sessions held July 20 and 23, 2021.
allegations.key_passage: We are satisfied that the Board's discussions relating to the Piccirilli litigation were proper for executive session, and the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law as alleged.

allegations.summary: Complainants alleged the Board deliberated outside a posted meeting about appointing the building inspector; the AG had already reviewed this in OML 2022-28.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore decline to review this allegation here.
